decisions.note: Pinned skill 203741 is Japanese 刹那の勝機. The zh-CN title is not a literal title match and several natural Vietnamese renderings are plausible; defer.
Pinned skill 300021 is Japanese 変わらぬままで. This is a scenario-flavored phrase with multiple natural Vietnamese renderings; no stable reviewed term exists.
Pinned skill 109601211 is a character-specific evolution title. The current repository/public evidence does not establish a sufficiently verified canonical Vietnamese title, so defer.
Pinned skill 105102211 is Japanese ヴェール揺らす春疾風. The title is poetic and the zh-CN wording is interpretive; defer instead of fixing one Vietnamese poetic rendering.
Pinned skill 202591 is exactly 一気呵成. 'Một mạch hoàn thành' preserves the established idiom meaning naturally in Vietnamese without relying on the Chinese spelling as authority.
Pinned skill 106103221 is Japanese 一流の在り方. The source shifts the nuance from 'way/state of being first-rate' to 'first-rate existence'; defer the canonical Vietnamese title.
Pinned skill 202771 is exactly 一点集中; 'Tập trung một điểm' is a direct, stable and natural Vietnamese rendering.
Pinned skill 100711 is Japanese 一期の夢、刹那の飛翔. It is a poetic character title and the source wording is interpretive; defer rather than canonicalize a guessed literary rendering.
Pinned skill 210061 is Japanese 一番星. The phrase can denote the first visible evening star as well as literally 'first star'; defer until the project chooses a stable Vietnamese convention.

The source is an idiomatic skill title at locator 204501, but the exact current Japanese title could not be verified strongly enough from the available evidence. Defer rather than assume equivalence from Chinese.
Pinned skill 107001211 is Japanese 一等星のアラベスク. The source replaces the specific 'arabesque' image with a generic ornate tune; defer the Vietnamese literary title.
Pinned skill 203522 is Japanese 垣間見た光. The zh-CN title changes the image to a ray of dawn, so it is unsafe to lock a Vietnamese title from the semantic bridge.
Pinned skill 101201 is Japanese 無二無三なる一条の路. This stylized title depends on word choice and rhythm; defer rather than flatten it into a guessed Vietnamese phrase.
Pinned skill 202851 is exactly 一網打尽. 'Tóm gọn một mẻ' is the natural Vietnamese idiomatic equivalent and is semantically stable.
Pinned skill 202852 is Japanese ごぼう抜き, referring to passing multiple rivals in succession. The zh-CN title is not title-equivalent, and several Vietnamese racing phrasings are possible.
Pinned skill 200552 is Japanese 押し切り準備. The source reframes the Nige-oriented concept rather than preserving the title; defer until a stable mechanical Vietnamese title is reviewed.
Pinned skill 203202 is 目にも留まらず. 'Nhanh đến không kịp thấy' preserves the fixed meaning naturally and clearly in Vietnamese.
Pinned skill 200371 is 一陣の風. 'Một cơn gió' follows the Japanese title directly; the extra 'cuồng' nuance in zh-CN is not imported.
Pinned skill 103502211 is きっと飛べる！. 'Nhất định sẽ bay được!' follows the Japanese wording rather than the more hyperbolic zh-CN bridge.
Pinned skill 202691 is 誰より前へ！. 'Tiến lên trước tất cả!' preserves the direct competitive meaning in natural Vietnamese.
